questions.q: How many years does quantum mechanics turn this year, according to the author?
questions.e: In the video: "Ove godine kvantna mehanika slavi sto godina postojanja" — this year quantum mechanics marks one hundred years of existence.

questions.q: What does the word "quantum" mean in the video?
questions.e: In the video: "kvantno označava diskretne, porcionisane jedinice energije" — "quantum" means discrete, portioned units of energy.

questions.q: What does the author compare quantum tunneling to?
o: An electron passing through a wall
questions.e: In the video: "u kvantnom svetu elektron može nekako proći kroz zid kao da nije ni tu" — in the quantum world an electron can somehow pass through a wall as if it weren't there.

questions.q: What does Heisenberg's uncertainty principle say?
o: You can't simultaneously know a particle's exact position and speed
questions.e: In the video: "ne možemo istovremeno znati tačno mesto i brzinu čestice" — we can't simultaneously know the exact position and speed of a particle.

questions.q: What happens to a system during measurement, according to the video?
o: It collapses into one of the possible states
questions.e: In the video: "sistem se kolapsira u jednu od mogućih stanja" — the system collapses into one of the possible states.

questions.q: How does the author explain the role of the observer?
o: Like the pause button in a movie
questions.e: In the video: "posmatranje deluje poput tog dugmeta za pauzu" — observation acts like this pause button.

questions.q: Who developed the Copenhagen interpretation, according to the author?
questions.e: In the video: "koju su razvili Niels Bohr i Werner Heisenberg" — developed by Niels Bohr and Werner Heisenberg.

questions.q: How do quantum computers differ from ordinary ones?
o: They use qubits instead of bits
They work only during the day
questions.e: In the video: "kvantni računari koriste kvantne bitove ili kubite" — quantum computers use quantum bits, or qubits.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Kvantna mehanika je najuspešnija *teorija*.
questions.e: Teorija — theory.

questions.q: Elektroni se ponašaju kao *talasi*.
questions.e: Talas — wave.

questions.q: Svaka *kaplja* predstavlja jedinicu energije.
questions.e: Kaplja — drop.

questions.q: Postoji *verovatnoća* da će se dogoditi.
questions.e: Verovatnoća — probability.

questions.q: Čestica može biti u više stanja *istovremeno*.
questions.e: Istovremeno — simultaneously.

questions.q: Ovo je *tajna* nit koja ih veže.
questions.e: Tajna — a secret; tajni — secret (adj.).

questions.q: Merni *aparat* utiče na sistem.
questions.e: Aparat — device, apparatus.

questions.q: Zapletenost je *fascinantan* fenomen.
questions.e: Fascinantan — fascinating.

questions.q: Kvantna mehanika se bavi predikcijom ___ čestica.
questions.e: Predikcija + genitive case: predikcijom ponašanja čestica — "predicting the behavior of particles".

questions.q: Elektron se kreće oko ___.
questions.e: Oko + genitive case: oko atoma.

questions.q: Zamislite česticu koja se nalazi u ___ stanju.
questions.e: U + locative case, neuter: u jednom stanju.

questions.q: Pritisnuli ste ___ za pauzu.
questions.e: Pritisnuti + accusative case, neuter: dugme.

questions.q: Ovo dovodi u pitanje našu percepciju ___.
questions.e: Percepcija + genitive case: percepciju stvarnosti — "perception of reality".

questions.q: Eksperiment je pokazao ___ zapletenosti.
questions.e: Pokazati + accusative case: postojanje.

questions.q: Čestica nije samo talas, već i ___.
questions.e: Nominative after "već i": čestica.

questions.q: Razmišljamo o ___ univerzumima.
questions.e: O + locative plural: o paralelnim univerzumima.
